coverage: version()/Version saves each successful merge handle
limitations: Only chronological successful-merge versions here; existing LC persistent_unionfind remains needed for arbitrary branching versions.
No restore, copy/move/exception or externally supplied foreign handle exercised by this problem.
Maximum-constraint timing/RSS and large balanced-merge modular check are handled separately by root agent.
proof: Edges arrive in nondecreasing weight order: adding an edge inside one component cannot lower any existing minimax distance.
A merge with weight w newly connects exactly sizeA*sizeB unordered pairs, all at minimax distance w; old internal distances stay unchanged.
The first retained version connecting distinct u,v corresponds exactly to their minimax distance; self-distance is zero.
A disconnected type-2 query outputs -1 without updating X.
After modular reduction each multiplication is at most (998244353-1)*200000 < 2**63; component-sum addition is less than 3*998244353.
Version handles are retained while their owning uf object remains alive.

complexity.space: O(N log(N+1)) persistent nodes; at most N retained versions

notes.oracle: Independent all-pairs Floyd minimax closure after every inserted edge; all type-2 answers and component pair sums directly read/summed from matrix. No Union-Find, retained versions or threshold binary search in reference.
